A1.justification: Both complete 49-page PDFs describe Uni-DPO and contain matching main sections and appendices A–I. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison; the localized formatting defect in v4 does not obscure essential evidence.

before.justification: v3 reports original Uni-DPO experiments on textual understanding, mathematical reasoning and multimodal tasks, together with ablations and training analyses (Tables 1–3 and Appendix D).

after.justification: v4 retains the original Uni-DPO experimental results across textual, mathematical and multimodal tasks, including the main evaluations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The quality and performance weights, length normalization, calibrated NLL loss and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The index corrections in Appendix E.1 align its restated objectives with the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use UltraFeedback, NuminaMath and MM-RLHF, with the same textual, mathematical, multimodal and downstream evaluation coverage (Section 4 and Appendices C–D). No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged within corresponding experiments, including DPO and SimPO, the advanced mathematical methods in Table D.5, and β-DPO and D²PO in Table F.1. The newly cited Uni-OPD is not evaluated.

E3.justification: Data splits, sample counts, model configurations, training settings, decoding procedures, judges and metrics are retained (Tables C.1, C.3 and D.1; Appendix D.1). Changes to their descriptions are grammatical.

E4.justification: The component and expert-model ablations, parameter sensitivity studies, overfitting and training-dynamics analyses, and case studies are retained. Figures 4–6, C.1, D.1 and G.1–G.7 introduce no new analytical evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions specify seed 42 in Tables C.1 and C.3, single-run pass@1 in Appendix D.1, and the same standard-error and 95% confidence-interval reporting in Table D.8. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Gemma-2-9B-IT retains 67.1 Arena-Hard WR, and Uni-DPO retains mathematical averages of 49.54 and 56.80 for the 1.5B and 7B models (Tables 1–2).

T1.justification: Appendix E.1 corrects rejected-response likelihoods in Eqs. (31) and (34): the predicted quantity changes from the already-conditioned prefix to token t, while retaining the prefix as conditioning history. This repairs localized mathematical errors; the remaining derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about dynamic weighting based on data quality and learning difficulty, and the same performance, scalability and generalization claims across task domains.

C2.justification: Explanations of overfitting, focal-weight stability, length normalization and c-NLL retain their meaning. Limitations concerning data quality, the 2B multimodal evaluation and possible future indicator refinement are also unchanged (Section 5 and Appendices D–E).

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is retained, including Algorithm 1, hyperparameters, scoring and preprocessing instructions, FLOP estimates, eight H800 GPUs, and code/data/checkpoint access statements. v4's hardware and training-description edits disclose no additional settings.

R1.justification: v4 adds Hou et al. (2026), Uni-OPD, to Appendix F.1 and the bibliography without developing a new comparison or changing the surrounding positioning. Other reference changes concern metadata, capitalization or consolidation of a duplicate Zheng et al. entry.

P1.justification: v4 makes scattered grammatical and spelling corrections, adjusts author superscript punctuation, and standardizes bibliography text. Examples include 'adjusts' to 'adjust' and 'waighting' to 'weighting'. The narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Several tables undergo small spacing and alignment changes. Table D.5 gains a malformed 'multirow6*' string beside its repositioned 'Supervised Fine-tuning' label. No figures or tables are added or removed, and plotted content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting rejected-token likelihoods in Eqs. (31) and (34), together with copyediting and reference cleanup, modestly improves precision and readability. The malformed label in Table D.5 is a localized setback, with its comparisons still readable. This limits the gain; the method, empirical evidence and scientific conclusions remain unchanged.
